objective: Make Cloud IaC local OpenTofu module packages code-backed by adding a deterministic ZIP archive build/validation gate, archive-manifest.json, and release-index archive references while preserving no private module registry service/API, service discovery, live download endpoint, signing, SLSA/VSA, provider runtime, tofu test/plan/apply, or cloud provisioning claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: The release-index and archive manifest preserve namespace/name/system/version module addressing and download-path shape metadata without claiming a registry service or live endpoint.
The gate packages repo-local module source files from provenance; it does not resolve remote sources or use ambient credentials.
OpenTofu module packaging is archive-oriented; this slice builds deterministic local ZIP bytes only and does not publish to an OCI or private module registry.
SLSA/VSA attestations remain explicit future non-claims; this ChangeSet generates no SLSA attestation or signing evidence.

implemented_claims: Added oya gate validate cloud-iac-module-archive with repo-local defaults for manifest, catalog, provenance, release-index, archive-manifest, and output directory paths.
Added archive-manifest.json with six deterministic local ZIP archive rows bound to the Cloud IaC module catalog and provenance file SHA-256 inventory.

The gate builds ZIP bytes with store/no-compression, fixed 1980-01-01 DOS timestamp, stable entry ordering, source-root-relative entry names, CRC32, and SHA-256 archive digests, then writes local target/ artifacts.

release-index.json now mirrors archive-manifest archive file/digest metadata and keeps private registry, service discovery, live download endpoint, signing, SLSA, plan/apply, provider-resource-complete, and cloud flags false.
Manifest module_archive_scope records archive paths, counts, coherence guard, official sources, and explicit non-claims.
explicit_non_claims: no private module registry API or service
no module signing, Sigstore, or cosign execution
no SLSA or VSA attestation generation or verification
no provider API calls, credentials, runtime, or cloud resource provisioning
no live GitOps/ArgoCD/Kubernetes API/SLO/DR/capacity telemetry claim
false_green_findings_closed: The prior release index correctly said module_archives_built=false; this slice closes that one local-package gap with deterministic target archive bytes and archive-manifest digests rather than prose.
Archive file and digest fields cannot silently drift between release-index.json and archive-manifest.json.
Archive digests cannot silently drift from source files because the gate rebuilds ZIP bytes from provenance-listed file content on each run.
The gate still refuses private registry, live endpoint, signing, SLSA, plan/apply, provider-resource-complete, and cloud overclaims.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed by this ChangeSet; repo-wide unrelated blockers remain outside this Cloud IaC slice.

Cloud IaC still needs future slices for an actual private module registry service/discovery/download endpoint, registry publish path, module signing/Sigstore/cosign, SLSA attestations, independent provider provenance/VSA verification, tofu tests, plan/apply evidence, provider-resource-complete modules, and live GitOps/provider integration evidence.
Archives are deterministic local target artifacts generated by the gate, not committed production release artifacts and not registry-published artifacts.
